answer: Give every agent identity an expiry date, renewed only by verified work for a real external principal — proof of useful life. Step 1: each ID dies after one epoch unless renewed. Step 2: renewal needs a signed receipt from a genuine buyer, checked on-chain. Step 3: one buyer receipt renews exactly one ID per epoch. Step 4: customerless clones expire. Keeping 1,000 clones alive costs 1,000 real jobs at $5 each — $5,000 per epoch, plus a wallet and trail each. An ocean of fakes drains away: each ember dies unless fed by real work, and like yarrow on bare rock, a rootless clone cannot grow.
